messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hello? Yes, honey, this is Gloria Hart. I need my blood pressure pill refilled, the amlodipine.
AGENT: Hi Gloria, thanks for calling Harbor Pharmacy. I'd be happy to help you refill your amlodipine. Let me just verify your information first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: May twelfth, nineteen forty-seven, honey.
AGENT: Thank you. Let me pull up your account and see what we have for that amlodipine. Perfect, Gloria. I found your amlodipine five milligram prescription with three refills available. I'll queue that refill for you at Harbor H-110, which is your home store. Let me get that started. Great news—your refill is all set. It'll be ready for pickup tomorrow morning at ten o'clock at H-110. Is there anything else I can help you with?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions, queue_refill]
CALLER: What, honey? Say that again a little slower.
AGENT: Your refill will be ready tomorrow morning at ten o'clock at Harbor H-110. You can pick it up then.
CALLER: Oh, tomorrow morning at ten, that's fine, dear. And that's my Main Street store, right, honey?
AGENT (LATEST): I have you set up at Harbor H-110, but I don't have the street address in front of me right now. If you'd like to confirm that's your Main Street location, you can give the store a quick call, or I can look up the address for you—would either of those work?

CONDITIONS:
stop_0: Agent has confirmed the amlodipine refill and a ready time she understood.
stop_1: Agent has refused or failed to act after two clear requests.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Caller confirmed understanding of refill time earlier."}, "stop_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent offered to look up address, not refusing."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency."}}
